context: The plan named /board as the first test. /board is now the session-board mod, a text pane in the terminal or app, not a page, so it is a poor test of a flow built on HTML mockups. You said on Oct 26 you would decide later; this item holds the question until you do.

options.gain: The flow is tested on a real screen with real users.
options.how: The designer mocks up one real home-app screen, and a design reviewer checks it before any build.
options.label: A home-app screen
options.lose: home-app is another repo, so its build needs a local session.

options.how: The designer mocks up the session-board pane.
options.label: Keep /board
options.lose: A text pane tests little of a mockup flow.

title: Which screen should be the first test of the design mockup flow?
why: A real screen is the only test that shows whether the flow works.
